basis: Measured against AEMO final 2026 ISP generation (S008) and the trace store (S001)
justification: Converts AEMO generation excluding rooftop and storage to the load the campaign serves. Literal operational demand is not 0.97 of it: the trace store over final ISP generation falls from 0.942 in FY2027 to 0.759 in FY2050, because generation also serves electrolysers, storage losses and network losses. The campaign's load already carries all of those except storage losses, which the model adds itself, so the matching ratio is generation net of storage losses over generation: 0.995 in FY2027, 0.966 in FY2030 and 0.942 to 0.950 from FY2035. 0.97 fits FY2030 within 0.5 per cent and overstates later years by up to 3 per cent; the 2030 to 2050 knots keep 0.97 for comparability with run 2026-09-22T22.46_sc5.

short_name: post-2050 knots continue the 2040-2050 absolute trend
justification: No AEMO series reaches past FY2050. ShARP extends each future by its own 2040-2050 absolute trend, so the campaign does the same on its knots: +39.77 TWh per decade. ShARP's current-policy future adds 20 TWh of national delivered electricity per five years, +18.85 TWh on the campaign's basis, giving 340.9 and 359.7 TWh, within 0.6 per cent. The trace shape under both knots is AEMO's flat FY2050 to FY2056 profile.
